name: Intersection 2 iMA
summary: This EA trades based on the intersection (crossover) of two Moving Average indicators (iMA). It opens buy positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and sell positions when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, implementing a classic trend-following strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA基于两条移动平均线（iMA）的交叉信号进行交易。当快速均线上穿慢速均线时开多仓，当快速均线下穿慢速均线时开空仓，是一个经典的趋势跟踪策略。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是双均线交叉，属于经典的趋势跟踪方法。入场条件为快速移动平均线与慢速移动平均线发生交叉——金叉做多，死叉做空。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或固定的止损/止盈设置。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算。资金管理较为基础，通常依赖参数化的止损止盈来控制单笔风险。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。双均线交叉策略的滞后性是其固有缺陷，信号产生时趋势往往已经走了一段。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is dual moving average crossover, a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions are triggered when the fast moving average crosses the slow moving average — a golden cross signals a buy, while a death cross signals a sell. Exit conditions typically rely on the opposite crossover signal or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing may use fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity. Money management is relatively basic, usually relying on parameterized stop-loss and take-profit to control per-trade risk. The strategy performs well in strongly trending markets but suffers from frequent false signals during ranging or choppy conditions. The inherent lag of moving average crossover strategies means signals are generated after a significant portion of the move has already occurred.

parameters.name: MA_Method
parameters.description: 移动平均线计算方法（简单/指数/加权等）

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和维护
经典趋势跟踪策略，在趋势行情中表现稳定
参数少，优化空间大，可适配不同品种和周期
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and maintain
Classic trend-following approach with stable performance in trending markets
Few parameters with large optimization space, adaptable to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 均线交叉信号滞后严重，入场点往往不在最优位置
震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续亏损
缺少对市场状态（趋势/震荡）的判断过滤机制
cons_en: Moving average crossover signals have significant lag, entry points are often suboptimal
Frequent false signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或ATR）以减少震荡行情中的虚假信号
加入移动止损（Trailing Stop）以保护已有利润
增加多时间周期确认机制，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or ATR) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement a trailing stop to protect accumulated profits
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 缺少对仓位是否存在的检查可能导致重复开仓
止损设为0时可能面临无限亏损风险
未加入新K线检查可能在同一根K线上反复交易
risk_points_en: Lack of position existence check may lead to duplicate openings
Stop-loss set to 0 exposes the account to unlimited loss risk
No new bar check may cause repeated trading on the same bar
